title: [AI][BACKEND] Market data service with fallback
summary: Delivered /api/v1 market data layer with live providers, fallback catalog, and canonical asset IDs for downstream watchlist, portfolio, and frontend.
problems_solved: Legacy routes used /api/assets with symbol+asset_type query params — inconsistent across consumers
No unified asset identifier — watchlist and portfolio would have duplicated mapping logic
Live provider failures broke local demos — no graceful degradation or source metadata
Error responses were ad-hoc HTTPException strings — frontend could not parse failures uniformly

technical.stack: FastAPI, httpx, CoinGecko + Finnhub/Alpha Vantage, Pydantic v2
decisions: Asset ID format stock:AAPL / crypto:BTC per investment-radar-api.md
All quotes expose source: live | fallback
OHLCV history with interval/from/to query params

context_for_future: Watchlist (INVES-21) and portfolio (INVES-22) must use asset_id resolver from market_data
Frontend (INVES-23) should read source badge from quote.source
Optional FINNHUB_API_KEY and ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY in .env for live stock quotes
Fallback catalog symbols: AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, BTC, ETH, SOL — extend in fallback_catalog.py
